Patch Set 2:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

The test change itself looks right: listing only $DIR/$tdir removes the dependency on what earlier subtests left in $DIR, mkdir_on_mdt0 pins it to the MDT that fails over, and osd*.*MDT*.force_sync is the form the replay suites use (server_ops in lustre/target/tgt_mount.c has no .sync_fs, so a host sync really cannot commit an osd-zfs target). Comments inline are small notes for whenever this is next refreshed.

Patch Set 2:

Patch Watcher paused an automated run on this change because it needs a human decision:

Andreas's three threads ask for the stale post-eviction size to be treated as a client data-consistency bug rather than cleaned up in the tests. Should this change stay a test-only fix -- with the client stale-size issue (loi_kms / loi_lvb.lvb_size not rolled back when eviction discards the dirty pages) filed as its own LU, and the test_131 size assertion added there alongside the fix -- or should I hold this patch and fix the client stale size inside it, making test_131 assert size 0 after the eviction?

commit.message:
LU-20327 tests: clean up after recovery-small 131

test_131 leaves its file behind after client eviction.
Cached size or block count can then differ from server
attributes. test_155 lists the entire test directory across
a client remount, exposing that difference as a test failure.

Remove test_131's file on exit. Have test_155 compare only
files it creates in a directory on MDT0000.

Commit test_155's file creation through the OSD before
setting the replay barrier. The creating client unmounts
before failover and cannot replay that operation. Server
sync does not commit an osd-zfs transaction.

The client attribute consistency defect needs a separate
fix and regression test.

Fixes: 71f8e5d6506f ("LU-14708 ptlrpc: skip unnecessary client eviction")
